experiment: Counterfactual Background Replacement & Robustness Evaluation (Full Waterbirds Test Split)
objective: Causal stress-testing: Isolating avian foreground and transplanting onto bird-free inpainted real donor backgrounds across all test specimens

methodology.donor_cleaning: DeepLabV3 Donor Detection + Morphological Dilation + OpenCV Telea Inpainting (0 remnant bird pixels)
methodology.compositing: Order: 1. Cleaned Background -> 2. Feathered Specimen Mask -> 3. Composite
methodology.quality_checks: IoU overlap validation >= 0.55 & single connected component bird verification

findings.most_vulnerable_subgroup: Landbird on Land swapped to Water (Majority group relying heavily on foliage cues)
findings.robustness_summary: Full Waterbirds test set counterfactual intervention evaluating background invariance across all 5,794 images without dual-bird artifacts.

model_comparison.metric: Mean True-Class Probability Drop under Swap
